research.title: Electrode materials
research.subtitle: Structure, composition, and performance
research.description: We study how electrode structure and composition affect energy storage and cycle life, with a focus on reactions and degradation in lithium- and sodium-based rechargeable batteries.
research.question: How can electrodes store more energy for longer?
research.methods: Material design · Structural characterization · Reaction mechanisms
research.goal: Develop electrode designs that balance storage capacity and cycle life.

research.title: Electrolytes and interfaces
research.subtitle: Ion transport and interfacial stability
research.description: We investigate reactions between electrodes and electrolytes to guide stable battery operation. Our work considers ion transport and interfacial behavior in both liquid and solid electrolytes.
research.question: What happens where an electrode meets an electrolyte?
research.methods: Electrolyte formulation · Interface control · Ion transport
research.goal: Design electrolytes with a balance of ion transport and interfacial stability.

research.title: Electrochemical diagnostics
research.subtitle: From measured signals to device behavior
research.description: We use cycling tests, impedance measurements, and operando analysis to track changes inside batteries. These measurements connect the causes of performance loss with material and device design.
research.question: How can measurements reveal changes inside a battery?
research.methods: Electrochemical measurements · Reaction kinetics · Degradation analysis
research.goal: Relate measured signals to internal reactions and identify the causes of battery degradation.

join.title: Open Positions
join.introduction: Explore opportunities in materials design, electrochemistry and integrated devices.
join.application:
Send a brief introduction, your CV and research interests. Include the position title and your preferred start date in the email subject or message.
For postdoctoral inquiries, include a short summary of your research and selected publications.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description: Develop materials and interfaces for electrochemical energy storage and integrated devices. Connect synthesis, characterization and device-level evaluation.
positions.requirements: A Ph.D. in materials science, chemistry, chemical engineering or a related field. Experience in electrochemistry or materials characterization.

positions.title: Graduate Researcher
positions.description: Study electrode processing, reaction mechanisms and structure–property relationships through experimental and data-driven research.
positions.requirements: A background in materials, chemistry or engineering, curiosity about energy devices and an interest in collaborative research. Admission arrangements depend on the relevant graduate program.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Intern
positions.description: Gain experience in electrode fabrication, electrochemical measurements and the analysis of experimental data.
positions.requirements: An undergraduate student in a related discipline with a willingness to learn laboratory methods and commit to an agreed research schedule.
